_readme: Quote bank for ReflectionVideos (footage + on-screen quote, silent render; Quran recitation added in-app at post time). EVERY quote must be authentic and correctly attributed - real hadith (named collection) or exact Quran translation (surah:ayah). NEVER fabricate or misattribute; do not put words in the mouth of the Prophet (peace be upon him) or the Quran that aren't there. Keep quotes SHORT (fits ~16-20s on screen). `theme` is used to match footage; `source` is shown on screen. Add at the end; never reuse an id.

quotes.text: The best among you are those with the best character.
quotes.source: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) - Sahih al-Bukhari

quotes.text: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
quotes.source: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) - Bukhari & Muslim

quotes.text: The strong person is the one who controls himself when angry.
quotes.source: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) - Bukhari & Muslim

quotes.text: Whoever believes in God and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
quotes.source: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) - Bukhari & Muslim

quotes.text: The most beloved deeds to God are those done consistently, even if small.
quotes.source: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) - Bukhari & Muslim

quotes.text: He who shows no mercy will be shown no mercy.
quotes.source: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) - Bukhari & Muslim
Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) - Bukhari & Muslim
Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) - Sahih Muslim

quotes.text: Make things easy, and do not make them difficult.
quotes.source: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) - Sahih al-Bukhari

quotes.text: And He is with you wherever you are.
Indeed, in the remembrance of God do hearts find rest.
So remember Me; I will remember you.
God does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.
And whoever puts his trust in God, He is sufficient for him.
Smiling at your brother is charity.
quotes.source: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) - Jami at-Tirmidhi
